title: Constructible high fibre-dimension locus contains a pure base change
statement:
Let $f:X\to T$ be a finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] which is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and let $d\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$. Using scheme-theoretic fibres [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and topological dimension at a point [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], put
$$U=\{x\in X\mid\dim_x(X_{f(x)})\le d-1\},\qquad E=|X|\setminus U,$$
where $d-1$ is subtraction in $\mathbf Z$. Then $U$ is open and retrocompact and $E$ is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]; when $d=0$, $U=\varnothing$ and $E=|X|$. For any morphism $g:T'\to T$, let $X'=X\times_T T'$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $p:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to T'$. If every nonempty fibre of $f'$ is pure of dimension $d$ [def-weil-pure-dimension], then for every $x'\in X'$,
$$\dim_{x'}(X'_{f'(x')})=\dim_{p(x')}(X_{f(p(x'))})=d.$$
Consequently $p(|X'|)\subseteq E$, and every fibre of $f'$ has topological Krull dimension at most $d$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], including empty fibres. No flatness, separatedness, properness or finite type hypothesis on $g$ is required.

source.place: Tag 0EY2, lemma-descend-dimension-d, proof: middle sentences defining the retrocompact open and its constructible complement and proving image containment; the pure-base-change local and global dimension comparisons are made explicit.

proof.text: If $d=0$, every point of a fibre has nonnegative topological dimension at that point, since every neighbourhood of it is nonempty. Thus no point satisfies the bound $-1$, and $U=\varnothing$, which is open and retrocompact. If $d\ge1$, put $n=d-1\ge0$ and apply [lem-trf-retrocompact-bounded-fibre-dimension] to the locally finitely presented $f$. Its locus $U_n$ is precisely $U$, so $U$ is again open and retrocompact.

source.place: Tag 02G0, lemma-openness-bounded-dimension-fibres-finite-presentation; the d=0 endpoint follows from topology.tex, Tag 0055 (definition-Krull).

proof.text: By the constructible-subset definition, $E=|X|\setminus U$ is the single piece $|X|\cap(|X|\setminus U)$: both $|X|$ and $U$ are retrocompact opens. For $|X|$, intersection with a quasi-compact open $W$ is just $W$. Hence $E$ is constructible. When $d=0$, Step 1 gives $E=|X|$.

source.place: Tag 0EY2, lemma-descend-dimension-d, sentence defining E; topology.tex, Tag 005G (definition-constructible).

proof.text: Finite type implies locally finite type by definition. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-lft-base-change] first along $g:T\prime\to T$ to obtain that $f\prime:X\prime\to T\prime$ is locally of finite type, then along $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t\prime)\to T\prime$. By the scheme-theoretic fibre definition, the latter base change is the structure morphism $Y=X\prime_{t\prime}\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t\prime)$. Thus every such fibre is locally of finite type over its residue field.

source.place: Tag 01T4, lemma-base-change-finite-type; fibres are defined in schemes.tex, Tag 01K0 (definition-fibre).

proof.text: Fix $x\prime\in X\prime$ and $t\prime=f\prime(x\prime)$. The fibre $Y=X\prime_{t\prime}$ is nonempty because it contains the corresponding fibre point. The hypothesis and [def-weil-pure-dimension] say every irreducible component of $Y$ has dimension $d$. Apply [lem-sbc-equidimensional-open-local-dimension] with the field $\kappa(t\prime)$, the locally finite type scheme $Y$ from Step 3, and the open $O=Y$. It gives $\dim_{x\prime}Y=d$.

source.place: Tag 0A21, lemma-dimension-locally-algebraic, parts (3) and (5), applied to the pure fibre.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-fibre-dimension-after-base-change] to the given cartesian square: with $x=p(x\prime)$ it gives $\dim_x(X_{f(x)})=\dim_{x\prime}(X\prime_{f\prime(x\prime)})=d$ by Step 4. Thus $x\notin U$, since the integer inequality $d\le d-1$ is false, and $x\in E$. As $x\prime$ was arbitrary, this proves both displayed equalities and $p(|X\prime|)\subseteq E$.

source.place: Tag 02FY, lemma-dimension-fibre-after-base-change, part (1); used in limits.tex, Tag 0EY2 (lemma-descend-dimension-d).

proof.text: For any $t\prime\in T\prime$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions] to $Y=X\prime_{t\prime}$. Every term $\dim_yY$ in its supremum equals $d$ by Step 4; therefore $\dim Y\le d$. If $Y$ is empty the same theorem identifies its dimension with the empty supremum $-\infty$, still at most $d$.

source.place: Tag 0B7I, lemma-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions, including the empty supremum convention.

lean.statement: theorem pure_base_change_constructible_image {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (d : ℕ) : IsOpen {x : X | topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x) < (d : WithBot ℕ∞)} ∧ IsRetrocompact {x : X | topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x) < (d : WithBot ℕ∞)} ∧ Topology.IsConstructible ({x : X | topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x) < (d : WithBot ℕ∞)}ᶜ) ∧ (d = 0 → {x : X | topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x) < (d : WithBot ℕ∞)} = ∅ ∧ {x : X | topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x) < (d : WithBot ℕ∞)}ᶜ = Set.univ) ∧ (∀ (T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T' ⟶ T), (∀ t' : T', Nonempty ((pullback.snd f g).fiber t') → ((pullback.snd f g).fiber t').IsPureDimension d) → (∀ x' : ↥(pullback f g), topologicalKrullDimAt ((pullback.snd f g).asFiber x') = topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber (pullback.fst f g x')) ∧ topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber (pullback.fst f g x')) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧ Set.range (pullback.fst f g) ⊆ {x : X | topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x) < (d : WithBot ℕ∞)}ᶜ ∧ ∀ t' : T', topologicalKrullDim ((pullback.snd f g).fiber t') ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
